policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM enrollments e
  WHERE ((e.id = class_attendance.enrollment_id) AND (e.trainer_id = current_trainer_id()))))

policies.name: class_attendance

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM enrollments e
  WHERE ((e.id = class_attendance.enrollment_id) AND (e.trainer_id = current_trainer_id()))))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM enrollments e
  WHERE ((e.id = class_attendance.enrollment_id) AND (e.trainer_id = current_trainer_id()))))

policies.name: cohorts
policies.qual:
(is_admin() OR (trainer_id = current_trainer_id()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM enrollments e
  WHERE ((e.cohort_id = e.id) AND ((e.student_id IN ( SELECT s.id
           FROM students s
          WHERE (s.profile_id = auth.uid()))) OR (e.student_id IN ( SELECT ps.student_id
           FROM parent_students ps
          WHERE (ps.parent_id = current_parent_id()))))))))

policies.name: communication_messages
policies.with_check:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM communication_threads t
  WHERE ((t.id = communication_messages.thread_id) AND (is_admin() OR (t.trainer_id = current_trainer_id()) OR (t.parent_id = current_parent_id()))))) AND (((sender_role = 'admin'::text) AND is_admin()) OR ((sender_role = 'trainer'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM communication_threads t
  WHERE ((t.id = communication_messages.thread_id) AND (t.trainer_id = current_trainer_id()))))) OR ((sender_role = 'parent'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM communication_threads t
  WHERE ((t.id = communication_messages.thread_id) AND (t.parent_id = current_parent_id())))))))
